name: cognee-memory
description: Persistent memory for Claude Code, built on Cognee's knowledge graph. Captures your prompts, tool calls and answers, recalls what's relevant on every prompt, and carries decisions and lessons into later sessions. Runs locally or on Cognee Cloud.

cognee_base_url.title: Cognee server URL
cognee_base_url.description: Your Cognee Cloud instance, such as https://your-instance.cognee.ai, or your own Cognee server. Leave empty to run Cognee locally on this machine. A COGNEE_BASE_URL in your shell or ~/.cognee/.env is used only when this is empty.

cognee_api_key.title: Cognee API key
cognee_api_key.description: Your Cognee Cloud API key (ck_…), or the key of your own Cognee server. Needed when COGNEE_BASE_URL points the plugin at a server; local mode needs none. Kept in Claude Code's secure store and sent only to that server.

llm_api_key.title: LLM API key (local mode)
llm_api_key.description: The model provider key the local Cognee server builds memory with. Leave empty to run local mode on your Claude subscription (the observer). Not used with Cognee Cloud.

embedding_api_key.title: Embedding API key (local mode)
embedding_api_key.description: A separate key for the local server's embedding provider, when it differs from the LLM key. Usually left empty.

local_models.title: Local models without an LLM key (local mode)
local_models.description: Build memory without an LLM API key, on Cognee's local models (GLiNER and fastembed). The first run downloads torch and GLiNER, and the embedder differs from an LLM provider's, so use a new dataset. Off: with no LLM key and no observer, the local server is not started.

cognee_user_email.title: Login email (server without an API key)
cognee_user_email.description: Only for a Cognee server you run yourself and log in to with a user instead of an API key. Usually left empty.

cognee_user_password.title: Login password (server without an API key)
cognee_user_password.description: The password for the login email above. Usually left empty.

icon.title: Cognee logo
icon.description: Show the Cognee logo on the status row and on the credit line under answers. Set to none to hide it.

band.title: Status row above the prompt
band.description: Show Cognee's status row above the prompt: dataset picker, counters and current memory activity.

spinner.title: Show memory activity in the spinner
spinner.description: Add what Cognee is doing (recalling, saving, consolidating) after the spinner while Claude works.

tour.title: First-run tour
tour.description: On the first session on this machine, show three short hints under the status row about what it shows and does (/cognee-tour replays them).
